_README: THE RECORDED EXPECTATION, ONE ENTRY PER BUILD-TIME VARIABLE (TC-6).
This file is the single authority for what `import.meta.env` holds during
`npx vitest run`. Two consumers read these exact bytes, so they cannot
disagree:
- frontend/test/envPin.ts  APPLIES it, before any module is imported.
- scripts/check_hermetic.mjs VERIFIES it, in two environments.
A string value means: the harness pins this variable to exactly that value.
null means: the variable must be ABSENT from the run entirely.
Why a per-variable table and not one global 'the suite is hermetic' flag:
a flag is a sum, and a sum cannot see one addend collapse. The defect this
closes was ONE variable out of fourteen resolving from a developer's
gitignored .env; the other thirteen were fine, and a global count of
'0 leaks' would have needed only that one to be forgotten to read green.
Adding a VITE_ variable to the product? scripts/check_hermetic.mjs fails
until it has an entry here. That is deliberate: a new variable with no
recorded expectation is exactly the hole this table exists to keep shut.
Values are chosen to be UNREACHABLE, not merely different:
- test.supabase.co and api.test.invalid do not resolve in DNS
(.invalid is reserved by RFC 2606 and can never be registered).
- test.supabase.co is also the value jurisdictionUploadHint.test.ts and
periodGates.test.ts already stub, so the whole suite agrees on one.
- VITE_API_URL is pinned rather than left absent because the product
carries two DIFFERENT fallbacks for it: config/site.ts falls back to
https://api.cfo-ai.io (PRODUCTION) and lib/features.ts falls back to
http://127.0.0.1:8000. Absence therefore does not mean 'no target',
it means 'a target chosen by whichever module asked first'.
- VITE_PUBLIC_TEST_MODE is pinned to "" (test mode OFF) rather than
deleted, so the suite exercises the same auth posture everywhere.
It is "1" in this repo's untracked .env.local, which flipped
isPublicTestMode true on one machine and false on every other.
